data.heading: Week 2 (30 Jan - 05 Feb 2026):
data.text:
-  Minimum temperatures are likely to be above normal 1-3°C over most parts of the northwest, west, central and northeast India. It is likely to be below normal 2-4°C over East India; near normal or slightly below normal (by 1-2°C) over rest parts of the country.
-  Cold wave conditions are unlikely over any part of the country during the week.
-  Dense fog conditions are likely to prevail during early morning hours in isolated pockets of north India on some days of the week.

data.text:
